editions.credit: A little booke of Iohn Caluines concernynge offences whereby at this daye diuers are feared, and many also quight withdrawen from the pure doctrine of the Gospell, a …, in EEBO-TCP A17684 (STC 4434), trans. Arthur Golding (London: By [H. Wykes for?] VVilliam Seres, dvvellyng at the weast ende of Powels, at the signe of the Hedghogge, 1567). Transcription: Text Creation Partnership (EEBO-TCP, University of Michigan and Bodleian Libraries), keyboarded from the EEBO page images (CC0).

divisions.title: To the right 〈◊〉 ble, and • is 〈…〉 staye • Lord, Fraun 〈…〉, Lord gouernour of Barwicke, and one of the Quéenes Maiesties most Honorable priuie Counsell, &c. Arthur Goldyng wisheth encrease of Honour,
To Laurence Normandie a man endewed with excellent gyftes, Iohn Caluin sendeth gréetinge.
The woorke of Iohn Caluine concerning Offences, whereby in these daies diuers are feared, & many also quight withdravven from the pure Doctrine of the Gospell.
